Prove root 2 is irrational: Class 10 board exam ka classic proof, by contradiction, step by step from the assumption to hence proved.

• Assume √2 is rational: √2 = a/b, with a and b coprime (HCF = 1)
• Cross multiply and square: 2b² = a², so 2 divides a², and so 2 divides a
• Put a = 2c: 2b² = 4c², so b² = 2c², and so 2 divides b
• Now 2 divides both a and b, but they were coprime: a contradiction, so √2 is irrational
